tool_args.rationale: The target horizon of 20.5 is far beyond all pilot horizons, which end at 0.48. A slow-horizon probe can discriminate the proposed endogenous reversal and constrain its slow timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon adaptation law to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short horizons weakly constrain the slow component and do not establish the forecast-horizon reversal.
A finer short trajectory is less directly informative about long-horizon behavior.

considered_alternatives.option: Lotka-Volterra harmonic and Ricker dome models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot alone does not distinguish these candidates reliably at the target horizon.
It is irrelevant to resolving the horizon-dependent mechanism.
